paragraphs: My name is Tom, and I am twelve years old. Ben and I saw a notice at school on Monday. It was from Coach Matt, and it was for the sports club. It said, "Football game: Saturday morning at nine o'clock. To play: twenty baht. Film night: Friday, the sixth of November, at seven o'clock. The film is about snowboarding. It is ninety minutes long. Ticket: ten baht."

"Let's go to both," said Ben. "We must come early to the film, because there are few seats," I said. "How much is it for both?" asked Ben. "Twenty and ten is thirty baht," I said. We wrote the times and the prices on a small paper. Then I put the paper in my file. At home, I told Dad about the club. He gave me thirty baht for the game and the film.

On Friday evening, we went to the film night. We came early, and we had the best seats. The film began at seven o'clock. It was about people on snowboards on a big white hill. "They go down in one minute," said Ben. "It is fast, but it is hard," I said. After one hour and a half, the film ended. We clapped, and we went home.

On Saturday morning, we played football at nine o'clock. Coach Matt checked our names in his file. We ran for one hour. After the game, my legs were sore. "Are you sore too?" I asked Ben. "Yes, but it was a great game," he said. A notice gives times, days, and prices. We read it, and we did not miss anything.
